# 2 Kings Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 231r–232r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_010_page_001.jpg, 2KI_010_page_002.jpg, 2KI_010_page_003.jpg

---

**10:1** And-to-Ach'av [were] seventy sons [shiv'im banim] in-Shomron. And-wrote Yehu letters [sefarim] and-sent to-Shomron, to the-rulers [sarey] of-Yizre'el, the-elders [ha-zeqenim], and-to the-guardians [ha-omenim] of-Ach'av, saying:

**10:2** And-now, when-this letter comes to-you — and-with-you [are] the-sons of-your-master and-with-you [are] the-chariots and-the-horses and-a-fortified city [ir mibtsar] and-the-weapons [ha-nesheq] —

**10:3** and-see [ure'item] the-best [ha-tov] and-the-upright [ha-yashar] of-the-sons of-your-master and-set [him] on the-throne of-his-father, and-fight [vehilachamu] for the-house of-your-master.

**10:4** And-they-feared greatly, greatly [vayiru me'od me'od] and-said: Behold, the-two kings did-not stand [lo amdu] before-him, and-how shall-we stand?

**10:5** And-sent [he who was] over the-house and-[he who was] over the-city and-the-elders and-the-guardians to Yehu, saying: We [are] your-servants and-all that you-say to-us we-shall-do. We-shall-not make-king [lo namlikh] any-man. The-good in-your-eyes do [aseh].

**10:6** And-he-wrote to-them a-letter a-second-time [shenit], saying: If you [are] for-me [li attem] and-to-my-voice you [are] hearing [shome'im], take the-heads [rashey] of-the-men, the-sons of-your-master, and-come to-me at-this-time tomorrow [ka-et machar] to-Yizre'el. And-the-sons of-the-king [were] seventy men, with the-great-ones [gedoley] of-the-city who-were-raising-them [megaddelim otam].

**10:7** And-it-was when-the-letter came to-them, and-they-took the-sons of-the-king and-slaughtered [vayishchatu] seventy men [shiv'im ish], and-put [vayasimu] their-heads in-baskets [ba-dudim] and-sent to-him to-Yizre'el.

**10:8** And-came the-messenger and-told-him, saying: They-have-brought the-heads [rashey] of-the-sons of-the-king. And-he-said: Place [simu] them [in] two heaps [shney tsiburim] at-the-entrance [petach] of-the-gate until the-morning.

**10:9** And-it-was in-the-morning, and-he-went-out and-stood and-said to all the-people: You [are] righteous [tsaddiqim]. Behold, I conspired [qasharti] against my-master and-killed-him [va'aharegehu], but who struck [hikkah] all these?

**10:10** Know, therefore, that nothing shall-fall [lo yippol] from-the-word of-YHWH to-the-ground [artsah] which YHWH spoke against the-house of-Ach'av, for YHWH has-done what he-spoke by-the-hand of-his-servant Eliyahu.

**10:11** And-struck Yehu all the-remaining [ha-nish'arim] of-the-house of-Ach'av in-Yizre'el and-all his-great-ones [gedolav] and-his-intimates [meyuddayav] and-his-priests [kohanav], until he-left-him no-survivor [sarid].

**10:12** And-he-arose and-went and-came to-Shomron. He [was] at-Beyt Eqed of-the-Shepherds [beyt eqed ha-ro'im], on-the-way.

**10:13** And-Yehu found the-brothers [achey] of-Achazyahu king of-Yehudah and-said: Who [are] you? And-they-said: The-brothers of-Achazyahu [are] we, and-we-are-going-down to-greet [le-shalom] the-sons of-the-king and-the-sons of-the-queen-mother [beney ha-gevirah].

**10:14** And-he-said: Seize-them [tifsum] alive [chayyim]. And-they-seized-them alive and-slaughtered-them [vayishchatuum] at-the-cistern [bor] of-Beyt Eqed — forty-two men [arba'im u-shenayim ish], and-he-did-not leave a-man [ish] of-them.

**10:15** And-he-went from-there and-found Yehonadav son of-Rekhav [coming] to-meet-him, and-he-blessed-him [vayevarekhehu] and-said to-him: Is your-heart right [ha-yesh et levavekha yashar], as my-heart [is] with your-heart? And-said Yehonadav: There-is [yesh]. And-[if] there-is, give [tenah] your-hand [yadekha]. And-he-gave his-hand, and-he-raised-him up [vaya'alehu] to-him into the-chariot.

**10:16** And-he-said: Come with-me and-see my-zeal [qin'ati] for-YHWH. And-he-made-him-ride [vayarkivehu] in-his-chariot.

**10:17** And-he-came to-Shomron and-struck all the-remaining of-Ach'av in-Shomron until he-destroyed-him [hishmidam], according-to-the-word of-YHWH which he-spoke to-Eliyahu.

**10:18** And-gathered Yehu all the-people and-said to-them: Ach'av served [avad] the-Ba'al a-little [me'at]; Yehu will-serve-him much [harbeh].

**10:19** And-now, all the-prophets [nevi'ey] of-the-Ba'al, all his-worshippers [ovdav], and-all his-priests [kohanav], call to-me. Let-no-man [ish] be-missing [yippaqed], for a-great sacrifice [zevach gadol] [I have] for-the-Ba'al. Everyone who-is-missing shall-not live [lo yichyeh]. And-Yehu did [it] in-cunning [be-oqbah] in-order to-destroy [le'abbed] the-worshippers of-the-Ba'al.

**10:20** And-said Yehu: Sanctify [qaddeshu] an-assembly [atsarah] for-the-Ba'al. And-they-proclaimed-it [vayiqre'u].

**10:21** And-sent Yehu in-all Yisra'el, and-came all the-worshippers of-the-Ba'al, and-not-a-man remained [lo nish'ar ish] who-did-not come. And-they-came into-the-house of-the-Ba'al [beyt ha-Ba'al], and-was-full [vayimmale'] the-house of-the-Ba'al mouth to-mouth [peh la-peh].

**10:22** And-he-said to-[him] who [was] over the-wardrobe [ha-meltachah]: Bring-out [hotse'] garments [levush] for-all the-worshippers of-the-Ba'al. And-he-brought-out for-them the-garments.

**10:23** And-came Yehu and-Yehonadav son of-Rekhav into-the-house of-the-Ba'al, and-he-said to-the-worshippers of-the-Ba'al: Search [chappsu] and-see that-there-is-not here with-you any of-the-servants of-YHWH, but-only [ki im] worshippers of-the-Ba'al alone [levaddam].

**10:24** And-they-came to-offer [la'asot] sacrifices and-burnt-offerings. And-Yehu had-stationed [sam] for-himself outside eighty men and-said: The-man who-allows-to-escape [yamlet] [any] of-the-men whom I am-bringing into your-hands — his-life [nafsho] for-his-life [nafsho].

**10:25** And-it-was when-he-finished making [ka-khalloto la'asot] the-burnt-offering, and-said Yehu to-the-runners [la-ratsim] and-to-the-officers [la-shalishim]: Come, strike-them [hakkum]! Let-no-man come-out! And-they-struck-them with-the-edge of-the-sword [lefi cherev]. And-the-runners and-the-officers threw [vayashlikhu] [them out]. And-they-went to the-inner-city [ir] of-the-house of-the-Ba'al.

**10:26** And-they-brought-out [vayotsi'u] the-pillars [mattsevot] of-the-house of-the-Ba'al and-burned-them [vayisrefuha].

**10:27** And-they-tore-down [vayittetsu] the-pillar [mattsevet] of-the-Ba'al, and-tore-down the-house of-the-Ba'al, and-made-it [vayesimuhu] a-latrine [mosha'ot] until this day.

**10:28** And-destroyed [vayashmeid] Yehu the-Ba'al from-Yisra'el.

**10:29** Only [raq] the-sins [chattot] of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who-caused-Yisra'el-to-sin [hecheti' et Yisra'el] — Yehu did-not turn [lo sar] from-after-them: the-calves [eglot] of-gold which [were] in-Beyt El and-which [were] in-Dan.

**10:30** And-said YHWH to Yehu: Because you-have-done-well [hetivota la'asot] the-right [ha-yashar] in-my-eyes, according-to-all that [was] in-my-heart [bilvavi] you-have-done to the-house of-Ach'av, sons of-the-fourth [generation] [beney revi'im] shall-sit for-you on-the-throne of-Yisra'el.

**10:31** But-Yehu did-not guard [lo shamar] to-walk in-the-torah of-YHWH, God of-Yisra'el, with-all his-heart [be-khol levavo]. He-did-not turn from the-sins of-Yarov'am who-caused-Yisra'el-to-sin.

**10:32** In-those days YHWH began to-cut-off [leqattot] against-Yisra'el, and-struck-them Chaza'el in-all the-territory [gevul] of-Yisra'el,

**10:33** from the-Yarden [toward] the-rising of-the-sun [mizrach ha-shamesh]: all the-land of-the-Gil'ad — the-Gadiy and-the-Re'uveniy and-the-Menashiy — from-Aro'er which [is] by the-Wadi of-Arnon, and-the-Gil'ad and-the-Bashan.

**10:34** And-the-rest of-the-deeds of-Yehu and-all that he-did and-all his-might [gevurato], are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el?

**10:35** And-lay-down Yehu with-his-fathers, and-they-buried-him in-Shomron. And-reigned Yeho'achaz his-son in-his-place.

**10:36** And-the-days which Yehu reigned over-Yisra'el [were] twenty-eight years in-Shomron.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — seventy sons:** The number seventy is symbolic — representing totality and completeness (cf. seventy elders of Israel, seventy nations in Genesis 10). The destruction of all seventy sons means the total annihilation of Ahab's dynasty.

**v.6 — "take the heads":** The Hebrew *rashey* (heads) is ambiguous — it can mean "heads" (physical) or "leaders/chiefs." Jehu exploits this ambiguity: the rulers of Samaria understand it literally, which may or may not have been Jehu's original intent. The resulting massacre commits them irrevocably to his cause.

**v.9 — "You are righteous":** Jehu's rhetorical strategy is devious. By displaying the seventy heads publicly and asking "Who struck all these?" he implicates the entire city in the bloodshed. If the people are "righteous" (*tsaddiqim*), then the killings must be just — and everyone shares responsibility.

**v.15 — Jehonadab son of Rechab:** The Rechabites were an austere sect who rejected agriculture, wine, and settled life (Jer 35). Jehonadab's alliance with Jehu lends religious legitimacy to the purge. "Is your heart right with my heart?" becomes a test of loyalty.

**v.19 — be-oqbah (in cunning):** The narrator explicitly states that Jehu acts *be-oqbah* — with cunning/deceit. This is a rare editorial comment that colors the entire Baal-temple massacre as trickery rather than straightforward religious reform.

**v.29-31 — The narrator's verdict:** Despite YHWH's approval (v.30), the narrator delivers a devastating qualification: Jehu retained Jeroboam's golden calves (v.29) and "did not guard to walk in the torah of YHWH with all his heart" (v.31). Zeal against Baal coexisted with tolerance of other idolatry. Partial obedience is the chapter's final judgment.

*— EMET*
